description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: A cross-platform launcher that simply works
Super Productivity is an advanced todo list app with integrated Timeboxing and time tracking capabilities. It also comes with integrations for Jira, GitLab, GitHub and Open Project.
Local-first AI agent workspace for coding, writing, design, research, and automation — one runtime for desktop GUI and TUI.
Get tasks and ideas out of your head. A free GTD to-do app for desktop and mobile. Works offline, no account needed
Automatically tracks which apps you used, which websites you visited, and how much time you spent in each app throughout the day.
An open-source, cross OS, community-driven launcher. A lightweight alternative to Spotlight and Raycast. Made with ❤️ from Viet Nam 🇻🇳
A curated list of 450+ awesome open-source alternatives to proprietary SaaS. Deployment configs, self-hosting guides, and tool directory.

Termul is Terminal Ultimate Manager a cross-platform desktop terminal manager built with Tauri and React. Organize terminals by workspace with persistent sessions, multiple shell, split panes, embedded browser tabs, and a built-in code & markdown editor.

Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish on your Mac with EG-1 or S1-mini by Superwhisper, Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini/Claude key. Snippets, custom words, no account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.
Open-source workspace for professional document AI: reviewable agent edits, source-linked work, three-way document merges, and an extensible plugin runtime. Starting with legal work.
Automate your job: local-first AI task hub. Email, Teams, Slack & reports -> one timeline -> AI triage -> your coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) do the work, you approve.

Tiling that feels like it shipped with macOS. Settings instead of config files, seven layouts incl. PaperWM-style scrolling, native Desktops kept intact, Lua underneath. Accessibility only, never SIP.
Claude Code skill — delegate coding tasks to Mistral Vibe, supervise via git diff & save 50-90% Claude token usage

Self-hosted AI workspace with agents, skills, and tools (Gmail, Calendar) that runs entirely on your own provider API keys (BYOK). Bring your own keys — Groq, OpenRouter, NVIDIA, Hugging Face, Google AI.
